transformCandidates.conditionSql: SELECT CASE WHEN COUNT(*) >= 1 THEN TRUE ELSE FALSE END AS CONDITION FROM INFORMATION_SCHEMA.COLUMNS WHERE TABLE_NAME = 'PD_LDC_LATEST' AND COLUMN_NAME = 'NVM_NAMESPACE_ID'
transformCandidates.sql: WITH LDEV_CONF AS ( SELECT PI_LDS.DATETIME AS DATETIME, PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER AS LDEV_NUMBER, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT PD_LHGC_LATEST.HOST_GROUP_NAME ORDER BY PD_LHGC_LATEST.HOST_GROUP_NAME SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS HOST_GROUPS, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME ORDER BY PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS NVM_HOST_NICKNAMES FROM PI_LDS LEFT OUTER JOIN PD_LHGC_LATEST ON PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER = PD_LHGC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN PD_LDC_LATEST ON PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER = PD_LDC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER LEFT OUTER JOIN PD_NNPC_LATEST ON PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_NAMESPACE_ID AND PD_LDC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID = PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_SUBSYSTEM_ID LEFT OUTER JOIN ( SELECT PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN, CASE WHEN PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME IS NOT NULL THEN PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NICKNAME ELSE PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN END AS NVM_HOST_NICKNAME FROM PD_NHC_LATEST ) AS PD_NHC_LATEST ON PD_NNPC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN = PD_NHC_LATEST.NVM_HOST_NQN GROUP BY PI_LDS.DATETIME, PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER ) SELECT LDEV_CONF.DATETIME AS DATETIME, LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER, LDEV_CONF.HOST_GROUPS, LDEV_CONF.NVM_HOST_NICKNAMES, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE PI_LDS.READ_RESPONSE_RATE END AS READ_RESPONSE_RATE, PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDS.READ_MBYTES AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS READ_XFER_PER_IO, CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE PI_LDS.WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE END AS WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE, PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE, CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDS.WRITE_MBYTES AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS WRITE_XFER_PER_IO, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS RANDOM_READ_TO_READ_IO_RATIO, CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS RANDOM_WRITE_IO_TO_WRITE_IO_RATIO FROM LDEV_CONF JOIN PI_LDS ON LDEV_CONF.DATETIME = PI_LDS.DATETIME AND LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER JOIN PI_LDE ON LDEV_CONF.DATETIME = PI_LDE.DATETIME AND LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDE.LDEV_NUMBER;

WITH LDEV_CONF AS ( SELECT PI_LDS.DATETIME AS DATETIME, PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER AS LDEV_NUMBER, GROUP_CONCAT( DISTINCT PD_LHGC_LATEST.HOST_GROUP_NAME ORDER BY PD_LHGC_LATEST.HOST_GROUP_NAME SEPARATOR ', ' ) AS HOST_GROUPS FROM PI_LDS LEFT OUTER JOIN PD_LHGC_LATEST ON PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER = PD_LHGC_LATEST.LDEV_NUMBER GROUP BY PI_LDS.DATETIME, PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER ) SELECT LDEV_CONF.DATETIME AS DATETIME, LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER, LDEV_CONF.HOST_GROUPS, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE PI_LDS.READ_RESPONSE_RATE END AS READ_RESPONSE_RATE, PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDS.READ_MBYTES AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / PI_LDS.READ_IO_COUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS READ_XFER_PER_IO CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE PI_LDS.WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE END AS WRITE_RESPONSE_RATE, PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE, CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDS.WRITE_MBYTES AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_COUNT AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS WRITE_XFER_PER_IO, CASE PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDE.RANDOM_READ_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(PI_LDS.READ_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS RANDOM_READ_TO_READ_IO_RATIO, CASE PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE WHEN 0 THEN NULL ELSE CAST( CAST(PI_LDE.RANDOM_WRITE_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) / CAST(PI_LDS.WRITE_IO_RATE AS DOUBLE PRECISION) AS DOUBLE PRECISION ) END AS RANDOM_WRITE_IO_TO_WRITE_IO_RATIO FROM LDEV_CONF JOIN PI_LDS ON LDEV_CONF.DATETIME = PI_LDS.DATETIME AND LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDS.LDEV_NUMBER JOIN PI_LDE ON LDEV_CONF.DATETIME = PI_LDE.DATETIME AND LDEV_CONF.LDEV_NUMBER = PI_LDE.LDEV_NUMBER;
